jtwc.text:
WTPN32 PHNC 152200 COR
MSGID/GENADMIN/JOINT TYPHOON WRNCEN PEARL HARBOR HI//
SUBJ/POST-TROPICAL CYCLONE 08E (HERNAN) WARNING NR 012 CORRECTED//
RMKS/
1. POST-TROPICAL CYCLONE 08E (HERNAN) WARNING NR 012 CORRECTED
   01 ACTIVE TROPICAL CYCLONE IN EASTPAC

   WIND RADII VALID OVER OPEN WATER ONLY

   151800Z --- NEAR 15.8N 135.4W
     MOVEMENT PAST SIX HOURS - 255 DEGREES AT 10 KTS

   PRESENT WIND DISTRIBUTION:

   FORECASTS:

   WIND RADII VALID OVER OPEN WATER ONLY

REMARKS:
152200Z POSITION NEAR 15.8N 136.1W.
15AUG26. POST-TROPICAL CYCLONE 08E (HERNAN), LOCATED APPROXIMATELY
1149 NM EAST OF HILO, HAS TRACKED WEST-SOUTHWESTWARD AT 10 KNOTS
OVER THE PAST SIX HOURS.
THIS IS THE FINAL WARNING ON THIS SYSTEM BY THE JOINT TYPHOON
WRNCEN PEARL HARBOR HI. THE SYSTEM WILL BE CLOSELY MONITORED FOR
